findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: Changing this handler to inherit from StatefulDetectorHandler without implementing counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data makes it an abstract class. Detector.detector_handler unconditionally instantiates the registered handler, so accessing that property for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError rather than returning the previously working no-op handler. Processing such a detector also aborts processing the remaining detectors. Keep the placeholder concrete until the required stateful methods are implemented.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses a different group key from the evaluated occurrence
findings.body: test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence with group key "val1", but calls evaluate_group_key_value with "group_key". The new hook builds the actual occurrence using the evaluated group key, so its fingerprint is ['<detector id>:group_key'] while the expected occurrence has ['<detector id>:val1']. The result equality assertion therefore fails. Build the expected occurrence using "group_key" so this test can pass and verify the correct fingerprint.
